Your Parking,
Your Way

Step into a world of confident parking decisions with our app, providing real-time solutions for your parking needs.

Learn More Book Now

Seamlessly Park Your Way

Embrace effortless parking tailored to your preferences with our app, ensuring a stress-free and enjoyable experience.

Learn More Book Now

Diverse Parking Options

Find designated spots for bikes and cars, ensuring convenience and organized parking solutions
for all types of vehicles.

View Parking Facilities

Easily explore available parking locations.

Refer and Earn Option

Invite friends and earn rewards together.

Make Your Own Parking List

Create a list of preferred parking spots.

Book the Slot in Your Date

Secure your parking slot for your chosen date.

Real-time analytics

From average parking lot occupancy and revenue, all the way to the detailed parking

Revenue streams

Upon implementation overall turnover increases to up to 30%

Trend Analysis

Indisputable decision making based on historic data and performance tracking

Equipment status

Maintance costs are reduced by shifting the equipment management to digital

How Our App Works

xperience effortless parking with our step-by-step process. From choosing your vehicle type to booking your parking slot, our app guides you seamlessly through every stage.

  • Choose Your Vehicle Type

    Select bike or car for tailored results.

  • Explore Parking Options

    Browse available parking spots nearby

  • Create Your Parking List

    Build a personalized list of favorite parking spots

  • Book Your Slot

    Book your parking slot hassle-free.

  • Refer Friends for Rewards

    Invite friends, earn rewards, and park together.

Book Your Parking Spot with Ease

Navigate our intuitive app to seamlessly book your parking spot. Select your vehicle type,
explore available spots, and reserve your preferred space hassle-free.

1. Explore Seamless Parking

Discover a stress-free parking experience with our app's intuitive features.

2. Choose Vehicle Type

Select whether you're parking a bike or car for customized option

3. Browse Parking Spots

Explore nearby parking facilities on the map with real-time availability and distance indicators.

4. Compare and Select

Evaluate features of available spots and select the one that fits your needs.

5. Confirmation and Details

Evaluate features of available spots and select the one that fits your needs.

6. Navigation Assistance

Use the app's built-in navigation feature to guide you to your reserved parking spot.

7. Parking Experience

Enjoy a smooth parking experience knowing your spot is secured and waiting for you.

8. Create Parking List

Create a personalized list of favorite parking spots for quick access.

Live product implementation

Our product is live in Split Croatia. Together with our partners from Ericsson we've covered more than 1500+ parking spaces. On top of that, we've won the award for best smart city implementation project in 2018.
